answer: Because the sable count is verified against the fable text itself, the karst audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 129 aliases as a result means producing 129 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
